chunks: Sama'ah ibn Mihran asked him about visiting graves and building mosques upon them.
He said: "As for visiting graves, there is no harm in it, and mosques are not to be built near them."

key_terms.زِيَارَةِ: visitation, here referring to visiting graves
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to visit graves and build mosques near them in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith distinguishes between the permissibility of visiting graves and the prohibition of constructing mosques near them. It presents a legal ruling concerning grave visitation and the limits related to sacred building practices around graves.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.531 - Sama’a ibn Mehran asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about visiting graves and building mosques around them.
Imam (as) replied: "There is no issue with visiting graves, but no mosques should be built around them."
